requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
evidence: Address: Nahdi Medical Company, King Abdulaziz Branch Road, Jeddah, PO Box 17129, Saudi Arabia
reason: The policy names Nahdi Medical Company and Al Nahdi Care Company as the controller and gives a postal address, an email and a website for contact.

requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
reason: A DPO email address is given for data protection queries, but the DPO is not named and no other contact details are provided.

requirement: The personal data that is collected
evidence: The types of personal data we collect can vary based on the situation
reason: The policy lists the categories of personal data collected, including name, contact details, national ID, health information and payment information.

requirement: The means used to collect personal data
evidence: We will collect your personal data directly from you
reason: The policy says data is collected directly from the individual and from third parties such as healthcare providers and insurers, and describes online tracking and forms.

requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
evidence: Please see in the table below the key purposes for which we may use your personal data, as well as examples of processing activities
reason: The policy gives detailed tables of processing purposes for the online store, the clinics and marketing.

requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
evidence: We may rely on the following lawful bases:
reason: Section 3 lists specific lawful bases including consent, contract, legal obligation and legitimate interest.

requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
evidence: Collecting and processing your personal data is mandatory to fulfill the purposes specified in the table above.
reason: It states processing is mandatory for the purposes but does not distinguish which data items are mandatory and which are optional.

requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
evidence: Please note that if we do not complete the collection of personal data for the above purposes, we will not be able to provide you with a high level of service.
reason: It mentions a consequence of not providing data but only vaguely, as a lower level of service.

requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
evidence: We may, as could be required for the purposes listed in section 4 above, disclose your Personal Data to the following organizations:
reason: Section 11 lists recipient categories such as contractors, delivery companies, media partners, loyalty partners and regulators, with their roles.

requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
evidence: We may need to transfer your personal data outside of the KSA for processing.
reason: It says transfers outside the Kingdom may happen but gives no destinations, recipients or specific conditions.

requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
evidence: We will determine the period of storage of your personal data in accordance with our Data Retention Policy
reason: The policy states criteria (legal requirements and specific purposes) but gives no concrete retention periods.

requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
evidence: We will arrange safe storage of your personal data in our systems
reason: The policy lists storage systems and describes destruction, anonymization and non-reconstruction in the disposal section.

requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
evidence: You have the right to request erasure (destruction) of your personal data available to us, which is no longer required by us
reason: The policy lists the rights to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct and request destruction.

requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
evidence: If you would like to know more about your rights or if you would like to exercise any of them, please contact us via DPO@nahdi.sa
reason: The policy gives an email contact and a website form for submitting rights requests.

evidence: You may withdraw your consent with the use of the form at the following website - https://www.nahdi.sa/dsr-english/
reason: The policy states that consent can be withdrawn at any time and gives the method.

requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
evidence: We apply encryption and other techniques to protect your personal data.
reason: Section 10 lists specific protective measures: policies and procedures, employee training and encryption.

requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
reason: The policy never says whether any decisions are made solely by automated processing.
